svg.title: A Petri-net blueprint in ADK YAML and two nets side by side. The obvious guard, where won inhibits the commit, is deadlock-free, but Z3 finds both commits starting before either lands, so two answers leave. The fix, where each commit consumes the one permit, proves both claims.
svg.text: commit only while nobody has won.
root_agent.yaml an ADK agent config, served by adk run

text.tspan: Two branches race; the first to finish answers.

svg.text: ✗ The obvious guard is deadlock-free, and Z3 still finds
the run in which both commits start while won is empty
(marking 5). Both land, and two answers leave.
✓ With one permit that each commit must consume,
only one commit can start. Both claims are proven.

text.tspan: Every panel is generated from the two YAML files.
